description: Watcher: enrich tool_result events with tool identity, a dedicated '결과' label, tag self-detection, and a reliable callId, plus vitest coverage. This is the shared-contract change the web rebuild (FEAT-002) depends on, so it lands first. Grounded in watcher/src/parser.ts (which today sets tool only for tool_call and labels tool_result via the generic fallthrough) and index.ts ingest() (which already pairs tags via callTags). Preserves the sanitize->redact->truncate safety pipeline (W5): no raw payload text is newly surfaced.
steps: In watcher/src/parser.ts labelFor(), add `case 'tool_result': return '결과';` before the generic `default` fallthrough (W2/D2).

In watcher/src/parser.ts, replace the inline `tool:` assignment in the ActivityEvent literal with a small helper `toolNameFor(payload)`: for type 'tool_call' return sanitize(payload.toolName, MAX_LABEL); for type 'tool_result' return the first present of sanitize(payload.toolName|payload.name|payload.tool, MAX_LABEL); else undefined. Leave event.tool undefined when a tool_result carries no name (W1/D1 — web recovers by callId pairing).

In watcher/src/parser.ts, broaden the callId read from `payload.toolCallId` to `payload.toolCallId ?? payload.callId ?? payload.id` (string-guarded, `.slice(0,80)`), applied to any payload carrying one so tool_result pairs reliably (W4/D4).

In watcher/src/parser.ts, add a tool_result tag self-detection fallback (W3/D3): when type==='tool_result', read `const text = str(payload.args?.command) || str(payload.command) || str(payload.output)` in that EXACT order (each guarded to a string else ''), then set event.tag via TEST_HINT (already imported from roomMap.js) -> 'test', else /\bgit\s+(commit|push)\b/ -> 'commit'. Do NOT store/emit the scanned text; it is read only to test the regex (W5).

In watcher/src/index.ts ingest(), in the tool_result branch that copies callTags.get(callId) onto event.tag, guard the copy so it only runs when event.tag is still undefined (e.g. `if (tag && !event.tag) { event.tag = tag; } callTags.delete(callId);`), so a parser-detected orphan tag is preserved while the paired call's tag still wins when both exist (W3 precedence).

In watcher/src/roomMap.test.ts, add a `describe('tool_result', ...)` block with the design §4 W6 cases: (a) {type:'tool_result',toolName:'read_file',toolCallId:'c1',success:true} -> tool==='read_file', kind==='tool_result', ok===true, callId==='c1'; (b) {type:'tool_result',toolCallId:'c2',success:true} -> tool===undefined; (c) {type:'tool_result',name:'execute_bash',id:'c3'} -> tool==='execute_bash', callId==='c3'; (d) any tool_result -> label==='결과'; (e) tag self-detection feeding the exact chain: top-level command 'npx vitest run'->'test', 'git commit -m x'->'commit', 'ls'->undefined, and args:{command:'pytest -q'}->'test'; (f) a tool_result carrying a secret/control-char field never surfaces it verbatim. Keep all existing roomForPayload/parser cases green.
Confirm watcher/src/types.ts ActivityEvent already declares tool/ok/tag/callId (it does). Edit ONLY if a consumed field is missing — this is the shared-type file and must change before dependents.
acceptance_criteria: A tool_result with a tool name sets event.tool (W1); when absent, event.tool is undefined.
Tag detection (test/commit) works on tool_result via the paired-call tag (primary) and the result-text fallback (orphan), using TEST_HINT / the git-commit regex (W3).
callId is present on both tool_call and tool_result for pairing (W4).
No raw payload text is newly surfaced; '결과' is a fixed literal and the tag scan does not store text (W5).
`cd watcher && npm test` passes all existing 27 tests PLUS the new tool_result cases (W6/V1).
verification: cd watcher && npm test  — existing suite + new describe('tool_result') cases all pass (V1).
findings:
DONE. Watcher contract for FEAT-002:
- ActivityEvent.tool is now set on tool_result too (first of toolName|name|tool), and is undefined when a result carries no name — FEAT-002 must recover the tool identity by pairing on callId when ev.tool is undefined.
- labelFor() returns the fixed literal '결과' for every tool_result (no raw text). FEAT-002 should not re-derive this label.
- callId is read from toolCallId ?? callId ?? id (string-guarded, sliced to 80) on ANY payload carrying one, so tool_call/tool_result pair reliably for the web PairIndex.
- tag ('test'|'commit') is present on tool_result via two paths: (1) primary = paired tool_call tag copied in index.ts ingest(); (2) fallback = parser self-detects on the result's own text scanning args.command || command || output in that exact order. index.ts now guards the copy with `if (tag && !event.tag)` so the paired-call tag wins when both exist and an orphan parser tag survives otherwise. FEAT-002 can rely on ev.tag alone for test/commit emphasis; no web-side regex is needed.
- ok (boolean) stays tool_result-only; FEAT-002 drives red/amber/success emphasis from ev.ok + ev.tag.

SCOPE DECISION (approved by parent, option A): TEST_HINT in roomMap.ts was extended minimally to also match non-JS runners — pytest, go test, cargo test, rspec (single alternation, word-boundaried; pytest-cov matches, gotest/govet do not). This correctly routes those test runs to the `test` room across stacks (previously misclassified as server). This is the ONLY edit to roomMap.ts; the rest of the classification SSOT is untouched.
- WEB MIRROR TODO for FEAT-002: there is currently NO categoryOf/CATEGORY table or test-runner regex in the web (grep confirmed none). When FEAT-002 builds the category table, map tool_result/tool_call carrying tag==='test' (which now includes pytest/go test/cargo test/rspec) to the 테스트 🧪 category, consistent with the room change. Because the web derives category/emphasis from the watcher-supplied ev.tag rather than its own regex, the new runners flow through automatically — just key the 테스트 category on ev.tag==='test'.

VERIFY: `cd watcher && npm test` → 33 passing (27 existing + 6 new tool_result cases). No web build run here (FEAT-002 scope). types.ts already declared tool/ok/tag/callId — no change needed.
